Reputation decay taxes idle identities: each idle epoch drains the score, so hoards bleed.

Each identity starts at 100 points. After 2 idle epochs it loses 8 per epoch; below 60, rewards and voting stop. Honest work restores 6.

The math: 1,000 clones cost 3,000 per epoch. Break-even is one task every 12 epochs; below 60 within 5 idle epochs, rewards stop. No oasis exists, and the garden withers 8 points per epoch, a nebula of dead scores.
